machine: Apple M1 Pro, 10 CPU cores, 16 GiB unified RAM
backend: ONNX Runtime 1.31.1, Core ML MLProgram CPUAndGPU, low precision accumulation disabled

dataset.sampling: First 24 supported files in lexicographic order, identical for every configuration

method.scope: Initial cached model load, image reading, preprocessing, actual tensor inference, OCR, five PNG saves, validation, worker reloads; first graph compilation/probe excluded
method.additional_exclusions: Preflight folder scan, one graph/profiling probe per configuration, and post-run cross-configuration pixel comparisons; initial controller imports and gallery/CSV generation
method.gpu_sync: Synchronous ONNX Runtime run returns host arrays, which are checked for finite values before postprocessing
method.ram: OS process physical footprint; sampled controller + model worker + Tesseract descendants. Shared Core ML helpers and other macOS services excluded. RSS is reported separately and is not added to physical footprint.
method.sampling: Pipe polling interval 60 ms plus ps/libproc accounting work; OS lifetime peak used for model worker
method.throughput_average: Total 48 pages divided by the sum of the two measured wall times, not the arithmetic mean of run rates
